entries.text: Adolf Rothermundt owned the work before 1923.
Max Silberberg owned the work by 1923 and until 1935.
The work was sold at Galerie Paul Graupe, lot 20.
A private collector in Germany owned the work.
entries.basis: Alexander, Graf Strasoldo, letter of 21 September 1998

entries.text: The work was sold at Lempertz, lot 289, to Galerie Nathan, Zurich.
Galerie Nathan bought the work at Lempertz.

entries.owner: Paul Rosenberg Gallery and Co., New York
entries.text: Galerie Nathan sold the work to Paul Rosenberg Gallery and Co.
The Art Institute of Chicago acquired the work in 1967.
